intended_behavior: Add new method(s) in the Plan class to facilitate visualization of the plan as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) or a table. These methods should create a representation of the tasks and their relationships that can be rendered to improve understanding of the planning. Existing attributes and functionalities should remain unaltered.

Modify or add functions responsible for plan output so that they call the new Plan visualization methods to display the planning as a DAG or table. Preserve existing planning and file generation logic while integrating the new visualization capabilities.
